Smoothing the damp paper flat across the oak table, he found no desperate plea from a marooned sailor, but an exquisitely detailed ink map of the very reef surrounding his tower, marked with a single crimson cross beneath the foundation.", "w02": "凌晨四点，整座城市沉入一天中最深沉的宁静。橘黄色的路灯在薄雾中投下冷清的光晕，高架桥宛如静止的长龙横跨天际。偶尔有运送清晨蔬果的卡车疾驰而过，发动机的轰鸣迅速消散在微凉的空气里。街角便利店的白光彻夜亮着，环卫工人挥动扫帚的摩擦声轻轻响动，在熹微的晨光到来之前，悄然拂去昨夜留下的尘埃。", "w03": "• Recursion is like putting two mirrors face-to-face, creating an endless hallway of reflections inside reflections.\n• In coding, it means a task solves a big puzzle by calling a smaller copy of itself over and over.\n• It always includes a stop sign rule, telling it when the puzzle is small enough to finish and return the answer."}
